questions.prompt: Which of these request methods is NOT defined as idempotent by RFC 9110?
questions.explanation: RFC 9110 defines PUT, DELETE and the safe methods (GET, HEAD, OPTIONS, TRACE) as idempotent. POST is not idempotent: repeating a POST can have additional effects, such as creating a second resource.

questions.prompt: DELETE is defined as a safe method by RFC 9110.
questions.explanation: RFC 9110 defines only GET, HEAD, OPTIONS and TRACE as safe among its methods. DELETE is idempotent, but it is not safe because it requests a state change on the server.
